_comment: Shared conformance fixture for the free-model filter, implemented twice: is_free_model/is_free_pricing in scripts/post_openrouter_free_models.py and isFreeModel/isFreePricing in website/src/cron.ts. Each case pins the agreed behavior of BOTH implementations. 'expected' is the shared expectation; the optional 'expected_py' / 'expected_ts' fields override it for a single implementation and document a known semantic divergence in an edge case that real OpenRouter payloads never hit (see KNOWN DIVERGENCES in scripts/tests/README.md). Do not add an override to paper over a real disagreement on realistic data — fix the implementations instead.
